newsitem.title: FRANCE: Corsican separatist surrenders to French police.
newsitem.headline: Corsican separatist surrenders to French police.

text.p: A Corsican separatist surrendered to police during the night, the third suspected guerrilla to do so in recent weeks, police said on Tuesday.
Andre Franceschi, a member of A Cuncolta Nazuinalista, was wanted in connection with a machinegun attack last week on a hotel in Aregno.

Two leaders of the group have surrendered recently. A Cuncolta is the political arm of the Corsican National Liberation Front(FLNC)-Historic wing. The FLNC staged several bombings on the French mainland recently, including one on Prime Minister Alain Juppe's mayoral office in Bordeaux.
Police said six bullets were fired early on Tuesday at the home of a government worker in Porto Vecchio. There were no injuries and no one has yet claimed responsibility.
